name: Landscapes of Dauria
description: Landscapes of Dauria is a vast stretch of open steppe straddling the border of eastern Mongolia and Siberian Russia. Grasslands, patches of forest, lakes and wetlands, including the Torey Lakes, shift between wet and dry spells over the years. This changing mosaic draws white-naped cranes, great bustards and millions of migrating birds, and it lies on a key route for roaming Mongolian gazelles.
